name: Agomelatine
metabolism: Mainly oxidized by CYP1A2, with smaller CYP2C9/CYP2C19 contributions. Hydroxylated and demethylated metabolites are inactive, rapidly conjugated and eliminated in urine.
summary: Agomelatine is an atypical antidepressant used primarily for major depressive disorder. It acts at melatonin and serotonin receptors; because of potential liver effects, product information recommends liver-function testing during treatment.
